bool ascii_less(string a, string b)
    int[] left := a.codepoints()
    int[] right := b.codepoints()
    for: index < #left
        if index >= #right
            return false
        if left[index] != right[index]
            return left[index] < right[index]
    return #left < #right

class Order(string id, int trader, string kind, bool sell, int price, int trigger, int peak, int quantity, string condition)
    remaining := quantity
    visible := 0
    filled := 0
    value := 0
    priority := 0
    status := "PENDING"
    history := ["ACCEPT"]
class Trader(string name)
    bought := 0
    sold := 0
    cash := 0
    fees := 0
    limit := -1
class Trade(int price, int quantity, int buy, int sell, int taker, int buy_fee, int sell_fee)
class Level(int price)
    visible := 0
    count := 0
class Engine()
    Order[] orders := []
    Trader[] traders := []
    Trade[] trades := []
    priority := 0
    maker := 0
    taker := 0
    band := 0
    tick := 1
    lot := 1
    halted := false
    string[] output := []
int minimum(int a, int b)
    return if a < b then a else b
int absolute(int a)
    return if a < 0 then -a else a
bool one_of(string choices, string value)
    for item := choices.split(" ")[]
        if item == value
            return true
    return false
int order_at(const Engine engine, string id)
    for: index < #engine.orders
        if engine.orders[index].id == id
            return int(index)
    return -1
int trader_at(const Engine engine, string name)
    for: index < #engine.traders
        if engine.traders[index].name == name
            return int(index)
    return -1
int register_trader(Engine &engine, string name)
    index := trader_at(engine, name)
    if index < 0
        index = int(#engine.traders)
        engine.traders = engine.traders.append(Trader(name))
    return index
bool resting(const Order order)
    return order.status == "OPEN" or order.status == "PARTIAL"
bool active(const Order order)
    return resting(order) or order.status == "PENDING"
int net(const Engine engine, int trader)
    return engine.traders[trader].bought - engine.traders[trader].sold
int last(const Engine engine)
    return if #engine.trades == 0 then 0 else engine.trades[-1].price
int pnl(const Engine engine, int trader)
    return engine.traders[trader].cash + net(engine, trader) * last(engine)
int exposure(const Engine engine, int trader, bool sell, exclude := -1)
    result := if sell then -net(engine, trader) else net(engine, trader)
    for: index < #engine.orders
        order := engine.orders[index]
        if int(index) != exclude and active(order) and order.trader == trader and order.sell == sell
            result += order.remaining
    return result
bool risk(const Engine engine, int trader, bool sell, int quantity, exclude := -1)
    return trader >= 0 and engine.traders[trader].limit >= 0 and exposure(engine, trader, sell, exclude) + quantity > engine.traders[trader].limit
bool outside(const Engine engine, int price)
    return engine.band > 0 and #engine.trades > 0 and absolute(price - last(engine)) > engine.band
bool matchable(bool sell, int price, int other)
    return price < 0 or (if sell then other >= price else other <= price)
int best(const Engine engine, bool sell)
    result := -1
    for: index < #engine.orders
        order := engine.orders[index]
        if not resting(order) or order.sell != sell
            continue
        if result < 0
            result = int(index)
        else
            previous := engine.orders[result]
            if (if sell then order.price < previous.price else order.price > previous.price) or (order.price == previous.price and order.priority < previous.priority)
                result = int(index)
    return result
string decimal(int value)
    fraction := value % 100
    return string(value / 100) + "." + (if fraction < 10 then "0" else "") + string(fraction)
void emit(Engine &engine, string text)
    engine.output = engine.output.append(text)
void history(Engine &engine, int index, string text)
    engine.orders[index].history = engine.orders[index].history.append(text)
void order_line(Engine &engine, int index)
    order := engine.orders[index]
    emit(&engine, "ORDER {order.id} {order.status} {order.filled}/{order.quantity}")
string details(const Engine engine, int index)
    order := engine.orders[index]
    price := if order.price < 0 then "-" else string(order.price)
    average := if order.filled == 0 then "-" else decimal(order.value * 100 / order.filled)
    result := "{order.id} {engine.traders[order.trader].name} {order.kind} " + (if order.sell then "SELL" else "BUY") + " {price} {order.status} {order.filled}/{order.quantity} avg {average}"
    if one_of("STOP STOPLIMIT", order.kind)
        result += " trigger {order.trigger}"
    return result
string position(const Engine engine, int index)
    trader := engine.traders[index]
    return "POSITION {trader.name} bought {trader.bought} sold {trader.sold} net {net(engine, index)} cash {trader.cash} fees {trader.fees} pnl {pnl(engine, index)}"
string trade_line(const Engine engine, int index)
    trade := engine.trades[index]
    buy := engine.orders[trade.buy]
    sell := engine.orders[trade.sell]
    return "TRADE {index + 1} {trade.price} {trade.quantity} {buy.id} {engine.traders[buy.trader].name} {sell.id} {engine.traders[sell.trader].name}"
void execute_order(Engine &engine, int index)
    while engine.orders[index].remaining > 0
        incoming := engine.orders[index]
        opposite := best(engine, not incoming.sell)
        if opposite < 0 or not matchable(incoming.sell, incoming.price, engine.orders[opposite].price)
            break
        maker_order := engine.orders[opposite]
        if incoming.trader == maker_order.trader
            emit(&engine, "STP {maker_order.id} {maker_order.remaining}")
            history(&engine, opposite, "STP {maker_order.remaining}")
            engine.orders[opposite].remaining = 0
            engine.orders[opposite].visible = 0
            engine.orders[opposite].status = "CANCELLED"
            continue
        quantity := minimum(incoming.remaining, maker_order.visible)
        price := maker_order.price
        buy := if incoming.sell then opposite else index
        sell := if incoming.sell then index else opposite
        buy_fee := quantity * (if buy == index then engine.taker else engine.maker)
        sell_fee := quantity * (if sell == index then engine.taker else engine.maker)
        engine.trades = engine.trades.append(Trade(price, quantity, buy, sell, index, buy_fee, sell_fee))
        number := int(#engine.trades)
        for affected := [index, opposite][]
            engine.orders[affected].remaining -= quantity
            engine.orders[affected].filled += quantity
            engine.orders[affected].value += quantity * price
            history(&engine, affected, "FILL {number} {price} {quantity}")
        engine.orders[opposite].visible -= quantity
        buyer := engine.orders[buy].trader
        seller := engine.orders[sell].trader
        engine.traders[buyer].bought += quantity
        engine.traders[buyer].cash -= quantity * price + buy_fee
        engine.traders[buyer].fees += buy_fee
        engine.traders[seller].sold += quantity
        engine.traders[seller].cash += quantity * price - sell_fee
        engine.traders[seller].fees += sell_fee
        emit(&engine, trade_line(engine, number - 1))
        if engine.orders[opposite].remaining == 0
            engine.orders[opposite].status = "FILLED"
        else
            engine.orders[opposite].status = "PARTIAL"
            if engine.orders[opposite].visible == 0
                engine.priority += 1
                engine.orders[opposite].priority = engine.priority
                visible := minimum(maker_order.peak, engine.orders[opposite].remaining)
                hidden := engine.orders[opposite].remaining - visible
                engine.orders[opposite].visible = visible
                history(&engine, opposite, "REFRESH {visible} {hidden}")
                emit(&engine, "REFRESH {maker_order.id} {visible} {hidden}")
void finish(Engine &engine, int index, bool stay)
    if engine.orders[index].remaining == 0
        engine.orders[index].status = "FILLED"
    elif stay
        engine.priority += 1
        engine.orders[index].priority = engine.priority
        order := engine.orders[index]
        visible := if order.kind == "ICEBERG" then minimum(order.peak, order.remaining) else order.remaining
        engine.orders[index].visible = visible
        engine.orders[index].status = if order.filled > 0 then "PARTIAL" else "OPEN"
        history(&engine, index, "REST {order.price} {visible}")
    else
        history(&engine, index, "EXPIRE {engine.orders[index].remaining}")
        engine.orders[index].remaining = 0
        engine.orders[index].visible = 0
        engine.orders[index].status = "CANCELLED"
    order_line(&engine, index)
void triggers(Engine &engine)
    while #engine.trades != 0
        int[] selected := []
        price := last(engine)
        for: index < #engine.orders
            order := engine.orders[index]
            if order.status == "PENDING" and (if order.sell then price <= order.trigger else price >= order.trigger)
                selected = selected.append(int(index))
        if #selected == 0
            break
        for index := selected[]
            engine.orders[index].status = "CANCELLED"
        for index := selected[]
            emit(&engine, "TRIGGER {engine.orders[index].id}")
            history(&engine, index, "TRIGGER")
            execute_order(&engine, index)
            finish(&engine, index, engine.orders[index].kind == "STOPLIMIT")
void cancel(Engine &engine, int index)
    history(&engine, index, "CANCEL {engine.orders[index].remaining}")
    engine.orders[index].remaining = 0
    engine.orders[index].visible = 0
    engine.orders[index].status = "CANCELLED"
    order_line(&engine, index)
Level[] levels(const Engine engine, bool sell)
    int[] prices := []
    for order := engine.orders[]
        if resting(order) and order.sell == sell
            found := false
            for price := prices[]
                if price == order.price
                    found = true
            if not found
                prices = prices.append(order.price)
    Level[] result := []
    for price := prices.sorted()[]
        level := Level(price)
        for order := engine.orders[]
            if resting(order) and order.sell == sell and order.price == price
                level.visible += order.visible
                level.count += 1
        result = result.append(level)
    return result
void | error new_order(Engine &engine, const string[] words)
    kind := words[0]
    id := words[1]
    sell := words[3] == "SELL"
    trader := trader_at(engine, words[2])
    price := -1
    trigger := 0
    quantity := 0
    peak := 0
    condition := ""
    if kind == "LIMIT" or kind == "ICEBERG"
        price = int(words[4])
        quantity = int(words[5])
        if kind == "ICEBERG"
            peak = int(words[6])
        elif #words == 7
            condition = words[6]
    elif kind == "MARKET"
        quantity = int(words[4])
    else
        trigger = int(words[4])
        if kind == "STOP"
            quantity = int(words[5])
        else
            price = int(words[5])
            quantity = int(words[6])
    if engine.halted
        return error("halted")
    if order_at(engine, id) >= 0
        return error("duplicate id")
    stop := kind == "STOP" or kind == "STOPLIMIT"
    if price == 0 or (stop and trigger == 0)
        return error("invalid price")
    if quantity == 0
        return error("invalid quantity")
    if (price >= 0 and price % engine.tick != 0) or (stop and trigger % engine.tick != 0)
        return error("invalid tick")
    if quantity % engine.lot != 0
        return error("invalid lot")
    if kind == "ICEBERG" and (peak == 0 or peak > quantity or peak % engine.lot != 0)
        return error("invalid peak")
    if stop and #engine.trades > 0 and (if sell then trigger >= last(engine) else trigger <= last(engine))
        return error("invalid trigger")
    if price >= 0 and outside(engine, price)
        return error("outside band")
    if risk(engine, trader, sell, quantity)
        return error("risk limit")
    opposite := best(engine, not sell)
    if condition == "POSTONLY" and opposite >= 0 and matchable(sell, price, engine.orders[opposite].price)
        return error("would cross")
    if condition == "FOK"
        available := 0
        for order := engine.orders[]
            if resting(order) and order.sell != sell and order.trader != trader and matchable(sell, price, order.price)
                available += order.remaining
        if available < quantity
            return error("unfillable")
    trader = register_trader(&engine, words[2])
    index := int(#engine.orders)
    engine.orders = engine.orders.append(Order(id, trader, kind, sell, price, trigger, peak, quantity, condition))
    if stop
        order_line(&engine, index)
    else
        if condition != "POSTONLY"
            execute_order(&engine, index)
        finish(&engine, index, kind == "ICEBERG" or (kind == "LIMIT" and condition != "IOC"))
        triggers(&engine)
    return void
void | error execute(Engine &engine, const string[] words)
    command := words[0]
    if one_of("LIMIT MARKET STOP STOPLIMIT ICEBERG", command)
        try new_order(&engine, words)
        return
    if command == "CANCEL" or command == "REPLACE"
        replace := command == "REPLACE"
        if replace and engine.halted
            return error("halted")
        index := order_at(engine, words[1])
        if index < 0
            return error("unknown order")
        order := engine.orders[index]
        if (replace and not resting(order)) or (not replace and not active(order))
            return error("not open")
        if not replace
            cancel(&engine, index)
            return
        price := int(words[2])
        quantity := int(words[3])
        if price == 0
            return error("invalid price")
        if quantity == 0
            return error("invalid quantity")
        if price != order.price and price % engine.tick != 0
            return error("invalid tick")
        if quantity % engine.lot != 0
            return error("invalid lot")
        if price == order.price and quantity == order.remaining
            return error("no change")
        if price != order.price and outside(engine, price)
            return error("outside band")
        if quantity > order.remaining and risk(engine, order.trader, order.sell, quantity, index)
            return error("risk limit")
        kept := price == order.price and quantity < order.remaining
        mode := if kept then "kept" else "lost"
        engine.orders[index].quantity = order.filled + quantity
        engine.orders[index].remaining = quantity
        history(&engine, index, "REPLACE {price} {quantity} {mode}")
        emit(&engine, "REPLACE {order.id} {mode}")
        if kept
            engine.orders[index].visible = minimum(order.visible, quantity)
            order_line(&engine, index)
        else
            engine.orders[index].status = "CANCELLED"
            engine.orders[index].price = price
            execute_order(&engine, index)
            finish(&engine, index, true)
            triggers(&engine)
        return
    if command == "HALT" or command == "RESUME"
        halted := command == "HALT"
        if engine.halted == halted
            return error(if halted then "already halted" else "not halted")
        engine.halted = halted
        emit(&engine, command)
        return
    if command == "RISK"
        trader := register_trader(&engine, words[1])
        limit := int(words[2])
        engine.traders[trader].limit = limit
        emit(&engine, "RISK {words[1]} {limit} exposure buy {exposure(engine, trader, false)} sell {exposure(engine, trader, true)}")
        return
    if command == "FEE"
        maker := int(words[1])
        taker := int(words[2])
        if maker + taker < 0
            return error("invalid fee")
        engine.maker = maker
        engine.taker = taker
        emit(&engine, "FEE maker {maker} taker {taker}")
        return
    if one_of("BAND TICK LOT", command)
        value := int(words[1])
        if command != "BAND" and value == 0
            return error("invalid size")
        if command == "BAND"
            engine.band = value
        elif command == "TICK"
            engine.tick = value
        else
            engine.lot = value
        emit(&engine, "{command} {value}")
        return
    if one_of("CANCELALL ORDERS POSITION FILLS", command)
        trader := trader_at(engine, words[1])
        if trader < 0
            return error("unknown trader")
        if command == "POSITION"
            emit(&engine, position(engine, trader))
        elif command == "FILLS"
            string[] lines := []
            cumulative := 0
            for: index < #engine.trades
                trade := engine.trades[index]
                buy := engine.orders[trade.buy].trader == trader
                own := if buy then trade.buy else trade.sell
                if engine.orders[own].trader != trader
                    continue
                cumulative += if buy then trade.quantity else -trade.quantity
                side := if buy then "BUY" else "SELL"
                role := if own == trade.taker then "TAKER" else "MAKER"
                fee := if buy then trade.buy_fee else trade.sell_fee
                lines = lines.append("{index + 1} {side} {trade.price} {trade.quantity} {engine.orders[own].id} {role} fee {fee} net {cumulative}")
            emit(&engine, "FILLS {words[1]} {#lines}")
            engine.output = engine.output.concat(lines)
        else
            int[] selected := []
            for: index < #engine.orders
                if active(engine.orders[index]) and engine.orders[index].trader == trader
                    selected = selected.append(int(index))
            emit(&engine, "{command} {words[1]} {#selected}")
            for index := selected[]
                if command == "CANCELALL"
                    cancel(&engine, index)
                else
                    emit(&engine, details(engine, index))
        return
    if command == "STATUS" or command == "HISTORY"
        index := order_at(engine, words[1])
        if index < 0
            return error("unknown order")
        if command == "STATUS"
            emit(&engine, "STATUS " + details(engine, index))
        else
            emit(&engine, "HISTORY {words[1]} {#engine.orders[index].history}")
            engine.output = engine.output.concat(engine.orders[index].history)
        return
    if command == "BOOK"
        depth := int(words[1])
        if depth == 0
            return error("invalid depth")
        bids := levels(engine, false)
        asks := levels(engine, true)
        emit(&engine, "BOOK bids {#bids} asks {#asks}")
        count := minimum(depth, int(#asks))
        for: offset < count
            level := asks[count - offset - 1]
            emit(&engine, "ASK {level.price} {level.visible} {level.count}")
        for: offset < minimum(depth, int(#bids))
            level := bids[int(#bids) - offset - 1]
            emit(&engine, "BID {level.price} {level.visible} {level.count}")
        return
    if command == "IMPACT"
        sell := words[1] == "SELL"
        quantity := int(words[2])
        if quantity == 0
            return error("invalid quantity")
        book := levels(engine, not sell)
        remainder := quantity
        cost := 0
        total := 0
        worst := 0
        used := 0
        for: offset < #book
            level := book[if sell then #book - offset - 1 else offset]
            total += level.visible
            if remainder > 0
                taken := minimum(remainder, level.visible)
                remainder -= taken
                cost += taken * level.price
                worst = level.price
                used += 1
        if remainder > 0
            emit(&engine, "IMPACT {words[1]} {quantity} insufficient {total}")
        else
            emit(&engine, "IMPACT {words[1]} {quantity} avg {decimal(cost * 100 / quantity)} worst {worst} levels {used}")
        return
    count := int(#engine.trades)
    if command == "LAST"
        emit(&engine, if count == 0 then "LAST none" else "LAST {last(engine)} {engine.trades[count - 1].quantity}")
        return
    if command == "SPREAD"
        buy := best(engine, false)
        sell := best(engine, true)
        result := "SPREAD bid " + (if buy < 0 then "none" else string(engine.orders[buy].price)) + " ask " + (if sell < 0 then "none" else string(engine.orders[sell].price))
        if buy >= 0 and sell >= 0
            bid := engine.orders[buy].price
            ask := engine.orders[sell].price
            result += " spread {ask - bid} mid {(ask + bid) / 2}." + (if (ask + bid) % 2 == 0 then "0" else "5")
        emit(&engine, result)
        return
    if command == "TRADES" or command == "BARS"
        size := int(words[1])
        if size == 0
            return error("invalid count")
        if command == "TRADES"
            shown := minimum(size, count)
            emit(&engine, "TRADES {shown} of {count}")
            for: count - shown <= index < count
                emit(&engine, trade_line(engine, index))
        else
            emit(&engine, "BARS {(count + size - 1) / size}")
            start := 0
            number := 1
            while start < count
                end := minimum(start + size, count)
                high := 0
                low := engine.trades[start].price
                volume := 0
                for: start <= index < end
                    trade := engine.trades[index]
                    if trade.price > high
                        high = trade.price
                    low = minimum(low, trade.price)
                    volume += trade.quantity
                emit(&engine, "{number} open {engine.trades[start].price} high {high} low {low} close {engine.trades[end - 1].price} volume {volume}")
                number += 1
                start = end
        return
    if command == "FLOW"
        buy := 0
        sell := 0
        for trade := engine.trades[]
            if engine.orders[trade.taker].sell
                sell += trade.quantity
            else
                buy += trade.quantity
        emit(&engine, "FLOW buy {buy} sell {sell} net {buy - sell}")
        return
    if command == "VWAP" or command == "SUMMARY"
        volume := 0
        cost := 0
        fees := 0
        high := 0
        low := if count == 0 then 0 else engine.trades[0].price
        for trade := engine.trades[]
            volume += trade.quantity
            cost += trade.price * trade.quantity
            fees += trade.buy_fee + trade.sell_fee
            low = minimum(low, trade.price)
            if trade.price > high
                high = trade.price
        if command == "VWAP"
            emit(&engine, if count == 0 then "VWAP none" else "VWAP {decimal(cost * 100 / volume)} volume {volume} trades {count}")
            return
        emit(&engine, if count == 0 then "SUMMARY trades 0" else "SUMMARY trades {count} volume {volume} open {engine.trades[0].price} high {high} low {low} close {last(engine)} fees {fees}")
    ranked := command == "RANK"
    int[] indices := []
    for: index < #engine.traders
        indices = indices.append(int(index))
    for: left < #indices
        for: left + 1 <= right < #indices
            a := indices[left]
            b := indices[right]
            av := engine.traders[a].bought + engine.traders[a].sold
            bv := engine.traders[b].bought + engine.traders[b].sold
            before := ascii_less(engine.traders[b].name, engine.traders[a].name)
            if ranked
                before = pnl(engine, b) > pnl(engine, a) or (pnl(engine, b) == pnl(engine, a) and (bv > av or (bv == av and before)))
            if before
                indices[left] = b
                indices[right] = a
    if ranked
        emit(&engine, "RANK {#indices}")
    for: rank < #indices
        index := indices[rank]
        if ranked
            emit(&engine, "{rank + 1} {engine.traders[index].name} pnl {pnl(engine, index)} volume {engine.traders[index].bought + engine.traders[index].sold}")
        else
            emit(&engine, position(engine, index))
    return void
engine := Engine()
int count
scan(&count)
for: command_index < count
    string line
    scan(&line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    engine.output = []
    match execute(&engine, words)
        void
            void
        error problem
            prefix := if one_of("LIMIT MARKET STOP STOPLIMIT ICEBERG CANCEL REPLACE", words[0]) then "REJECT {words[1]} " else "ERROR "
            emit(&engine, prefix + problem.message)
    println(engine.output.join(NL))
